definition: Randomly mirrors the image left to right during training. This teaches the model that a bird facing left and a bird facing right are the same species.
Randomly mirrors the image upside down during training. This helps the model recognize birds regardless of which way they are oriented in the photo.
Randomly rotates each image between ±36 and ±72 degrees during training. This helps the model identify birds even when the photo is taken at an angle.
Randomly zooms in or out on the image during training. This teaches the model to recognize a bird whether it fills the whole frame or appears small in the distance.
Randomly shifts the image brighter or darker during training. This helps the model handle photos taken in a wide range of lighting conditions.
Randomly shifts the contrast of the image during training. This helps the model identify birds in photos with washed-out colors or harsh shadows.
